messages:
samira: Hi team  newbie Q about Dependent Care FSA. My daycare started 2026-10-03 but my benefits effective date is 2026-11-01. Can I get reimbursement for the October invoices or backdate my FSA? cc @lisa :wave:
benefits-bot: Enrollment received. Dependent Care FSA elections are effective the 1st of the month following enrollment. Retro approvals depend on carrier/vendor rules. Please upload invoices to Expensify with category `healthcare-reimbursements` and note `dependent-care retro request`. See: https://redwood.intranet/benefits/fsa-dcfsa :link:
lisa: Welcome Samira  short answer: DC FSA can't be applied retro to cover pre-effective expenses per vendor rules in most cases. However, we can: 1) request an exception with our FSA vendor for qualifying new-hire windows, and 2) consider a limited one-time discretionary payroll reimbursement in urgent circumstances. Please attach daycare invoice + proof of enrollment and I'll open a benefits escalation ticket.
samira: Thanks  what exactly should I upload to Expensify and what category? Also worried about tax implications if it's reimbursed by payroll.
payroll-bot: Upload the full daycare invoice and enrollment confirmation to Expensify, category `healthcare-reimbursements`. In the description include `new-hire dependent-care retro request`. If we process as an FSA-qualified vendor reimbursement (vendor approves), it's pre-tax. If we issue a discretionary internal reimbursement, payroll will treat it as taxable income unless processed via the FSA vendor retroactively. We will confirm tax treatment once benefits vendor responds.
anya: FYI  we sometimes get faster vendor exceptions if you include a short note from the daycare showing the service start date and a signed parent enrollment. That helps the vendor verify eligibility during the new-hire window.
samira: Uploaded Expensify ER-55007 with invoice and enrollment doc. Created ticket #PO-6101 and asked for vendor exception.
lisa: I see PO-6101  thanks. Ill ping benefits admin and mark it urgent. If the FSA vendor denies, let me know if you want us to evaluate a discretionary payroll reimbursement; we'll document taxability in the ticket. Expect an initial reply within 3 business days.
benefits-bot: Ticket PO-6101 logged. Benefits admin assigned. If vendor approves, payroll will coordinate pre-tax vendor reimbursement. If denied and you request company reimbursement, payroll will outline tax treatment options.
samira: Appreciate it  I'll wait for the vendor update. Thanks everyone! :pray:
